name: Attack Ryotedori
label: Attack · Ryotedori — both wrists grabbed from the front
description: Uke takes both of Tori's wrists, each hand from the outside with the thumb on top. Tori offers both hands forward at hip-to-waist height; the two stand an arm's length apart, square-ish. In motion both hands reach as Uke steps in. Uke walks in from about two metres into it.
